ex.note: Do 15, 12, 10, and 8 reps. The first 3 sets should be pretty close to failure with great form. On the last set of 8, do 8 and then 6 forced reps, drop weight to first set weight then 8, then 6
Work your way up doing sets of 10 as warm ups. We are going to do explosive sets of 6 until we lose speed one you feel warmed up, and then do a challenge set - AMRAP with higher weight than last 6
Do a few feeder sets to get to a solid weight and then knock out 3 sets of 8 increasing the weight as you go. I want you to use a 3 second decent on these. No lockout
Come all the way up and flex your glutes. Do 3 working sets of 10.
4 sets of 15 with 30 second breaks. Wrap knee wraps around top of thigh, very high up by groin with tightness of 7 out of 10 (not so it hurts).
Keep doing sets of 8 until you can barely get 8. Last set is a drop set x 2. Get a great stretch and drive to 3/4 lockout
10 reps with a heavier weight, stretch at the top on 10th rep. Then drop weight and do 5 with a lower weight.  Do this on each set
On each rep touch your chest and drive hard to ¾ lockout then come right back down. 5 good solid working sets of 6 here ramping up weight as you go
Do 5 sets of 15 here. Take 45 seconds between sets. Flex each rep for a split second in the contracted position.
This is just laterals where you take the dumbbells up to the 10 and 2 o’clock position. So it’s not a strict side lateral or front raise.
I like to use a neutral grip on these with palms facing in. Drive up to lockout and flex your delt hard for one second and then lower slowly with good control.
Once you get to a tough 8 do CHALLENGE set. Go all out, do what you can, then drop a significant amount and go again, drop again and go again for max reps.
Keep your elbows high and your grip pronated. I am not worried about you getting a massive stretch on these. 3 sets of 8 after a set or two to find the right weight
Do 3 sets of 10 holding the dumbell in the contracted position for 3 seconds per rep!
Banded hyperextensions  – Do 2 sets of 20 (or as many as you can get) using a band.

ss.note: Squeeze hard at the bottom for 1 second. Do 8 reps here.
Prontated tricep kickbacks
Don’t force yourself to go deep into the stretch. Just go down to where your comfortable on each se
Hammer rope curl – Squeeze the rope hard here. Flex your bis as hard as you can on each contraction.
Heavy calf raise on leg press followed by AMRAP of bodyweight standing raises

ex.note: Do 5 to 6 warm up sets of 15 reps. We are going to just get a pump in hams, but not destroy them (we will do that later). Do the warm ups only.
Do a few sets of 10 as warm ups. We are going to do explosive sets of 8 until we lose speed and then do a few grinders too.

2 sets of 20 - Place feet low on platform, heels together & toes out. 20 slow reps (machine only first).
30's - do 20, rest a sec, do 10 more, ishold for 5secs 1/2 way, rest a sec, isohold again.
1st set - 20 reps with perfect form. 2nd & 3rd set - 20 reps and then 10 secs isohold 1/3 way
1st set - 15 perfect form reps. 2nd & 3rd set - do 15 and then force out another 5, then lift weight 1/3 way and hold for 10 secs
Keep doing sets of 8 working your way up until you can barely get 8. We’ll count the last 3 sets as working sets. Last set do 2 drops and try get 8 reps
Slight angle. 1st - 20 normal reps. 2nd - 15 reps, try to force another 2-3 out. 3rd - 10 reps, lower weight and hold for 5 secs. 4th - 5 reps, lower and hold for 5 secs
2 sets of 10, drop and do another 5-6 and then isohold for 5 secs half way.
On your 2nd set do something that is a tough 10, and then drop the weight and do another 10. On your third set repeat the 10 and then drop the weight and do 10 again just like the second set
Do one set of 15 with a flex in the contracted position on each rep. Next 2 sets when hit failure bring weight back a little and hold for 15 secs
Cage press –  Do 3 sets of 5 of these explosively.
Drive your elbows down hard and flex your lats. Lean back just a hair while doing these and maintain that position. Add 5 on to the last set where you force them out.

1 25 lb platex20 reps–Warm up
1 25 lb platex30 reps–Warm up
2 25 lb platex40 reps–Set
3 25 lb platex40 reps plus 5-set

Banded hyperextensions  – Do 2 sets of 15 (or as many as you can get) using a band. Stop at the top and flex your spinal erectors for a second

Alternate to failure. Make this somewhere around 12-15 reps. Do 2 sets like this. 3rd set once you hit failure stand up and do hammers. 4th set at failure hold both DB's 1/3 way up for as long as poss
Don’t go heavy. Use a lighter weight and just pump. Do sets of 20. Take plenty of time in between sets because I want 5 sets
Add in additional 5 on 3rd set and a 10 sec isohold, add an additional 10 on the 4th set and a 10 sec isohold
Do 4 sets of 8 with solid form. Try to get a little bit more of a stretch each set you do, as your elbows will feel better and better. I like to take the bar behind my head on the last set. Rest 30s
10 full, then 10 partials out of the bottom then a 10 sec isohold
Last set is a drop set - do 2 drops
Use the foot position where you feel the strongest. Simply do sets of 10 until you can just barely get 10.
This is where you do all your reps on one leg, and then do the other. It doesn’t take much weight on these.
4 sets of 15 with 30 second breaks. Wrap knee wraps around top of thigh, very high up by groin with tightness of 7 out of 10 (not so it hurts).
Keep the bar in nice and tight right against you and push your hips back slowly so you feel your hams working. Build the weight up as you go doing sets of 10, until 10 is brutal.
Simply keep going till you can barely get 8

Do explosive sets of 6 where you stop an inch or two from touching your
chest then drive up the weight hard and with acceleration. Do not lock these out
Do explosive rest/pause sets of 5 where you touch your chest then drive up the weight hard and with acceleration after a 1 second pause. Do not lock these out/ Keep going till can barely get 5
Take a weight you can do a perfect 10. Drop the weight after this and do 5-6 reps really controlled
Use a full range of motion here, and when you can’t get any more do 10 additional reps where you lock your arms out and just do swings only coming up about 6 inches. Full reps should be around 15-20
Grab a fairly heavy weight, with straps, and just swing them out to the side about 6 inches. Do not come up all the way like you would with a standing side lateral.
Do 3 sets of 8 o these locking out and flexing at the top. 3 total work sets.
This is the parallel grip bar that is wider than a normal close grip attachment. Want I am trying to do here is sit you in a position where you can just drive your elbows straight back
I want these done explosively. Set the stops so that you are pulling from about midshin. Drive your elbows up hard and flex your lats! Do these with an overhand grip.
Pull these from low to mid shin. I want perfection for form. Flex your entire back as you pull up. Do sets of 3 until you can barely get 3 with good form.
Now move the pins up so that you are pulling from just below the kneecap. Flex your entire back as you pull up. Do sets of 3 until you can barely get 3 with good form.

Alternate to failure. Make this somewhere around 12-15 reps. Do 2 sets like this. 3rd set once you hit failure stand up and do hammers. 4th set at failure hold both DB's 1/3 way up for as long as poss
You are going to get into a rhythm here like the preacher curls last week. Don’t go heavy. Use a lighter weight and just pump. Do sets of 12. Take plenty of time in between sets
Add in additional 5 on 3rd set and a 10 sec isohold, add an additional 10 on the 4th set and a 10 sec isohold
Do 4 sets of 12 with solid form. Try to get a little bit more of a stretch each set you do, as your elbows will feel better and better.

ss.note: Heavy calf raise on leg press followed by AMRAP of bodyweight standing raises

ex.note: Do plenty of warm ups. Here you are going to do 4 hard sets of 12 reps. The reps should be perfect. Keep a good pace going.

Work your way up doing sets of 10. Once you get to a really tough 10 you are going to do a drop
set. I want you to make 3 drops. 1st drop - 5reps, 2nd - 10 reps, 3rd - 15 reps
On your 3rd set you are going to do 10-12, hitting failure, then do a drop set to failure, then an isohold for 10 seconds
Do 2 sets of 20 here getting nice and deep on all reps. On the 3rd set do 20 reps and then do 4 isoholds holding for 8 seconds, locking out and then holding again - 4 lots
On your 3rd set do 15 reps, drop and do reps to failure and then an isohold 1/3 way up

Once the weight is kind
of heavy do sets of 8. Do these until your last set you can barely do 8. Then drop the weight and crank out another 8, then hold some lighter DB's a the midpoint
Similar to last week do sets of 8 on the way up. Just keep going up until you can’t get 8. We will count your last 3 sets as work sets.
Do explosive rest/pause sets of 5 where you touch your chest then drive up the weight hard and with acceleration after a 1 second pause. Do not lock these out
Do 2 sets of 12 where you hit failure and you flex hard on every rep. On the last set go to failure and then at the midway point hold for a 10 second count
On last set do a drop set to failure then an isohold at the mid point for 10 seconds
Simply do 3 sets of 10 here with perfect form, nothing fancy
Lean back just a tad and really drive down with elbows while you flex your lats. Do 3 sets of 10. On your 4th set do 10, quick drop set and then an isohold for 15 secs in the stretch position
Do 3 sets of 8 here, and then on your 4th set do a drop set. You will be using 25’s to get a fuller range of motion so just take a 25 off each drop (do 2 drops).
On your 3rd set, you are going to do 10 reps, and then let the weight hang and stretch for 15 seconds. Then drop the weight, and repeat for another 10 reps and 15 second stretch
Pull from mid shin. Do sets of 3 working your way up to about 70% of your max. Once you get here go ALL OUT for your challenge set and see how many reps you can do
Simply do 3 sets of 10 with a 3 second flex at the top of each rep
Straight bar pushdowns – I want you to keep your elbows tucked in at your sides and crank out sets of 20 reps with 45 second breaks.
Just like last week, but a little heavier for less reps. Do 4 sets of 8 with solid form. Try to get a little bit more of a stretch each set you do
Do a hammer curl on one side, and then switch. Alternate to failure (around 12-15 reps). On 3rd stand up and do hammer curls. On 4th go to failure and then do isohold 1/3 way up
Don’t go heavy. Use a lighter weight and just pump. Do sets of 8. Take 45 seconds in between sets because I want 4 sets
Do 3 sets of 8 on these and do a 3 second negative. Also on your last rep of each set, try to hold the rep (isotension) at midrange for 5 seconds
10 full, then 10 partials out of the bottom then a 10 sec isohold

Do plenty of warm ups. Here you are simply going to do 4 perfect sets of 10 reps. 4
total work sets.

Each set get a little bit lower, but don’t force it. Pyramid up doing sets of 10 until you can barely get 10. I do want you to lock these out and flex your glutes on each
rep.
Work your way up doing sets of 20. I want you to put your feet around the middle of the platform. Once you get top weight, do one more set of 20 with 10 sec isohold 1/4 way down
Take only 30 secs rest. On 6th set do a 10 second isohold.
On 2nd and 3rd set do a 10 second isohold after a single dropset
On your 4th and last set I want you to add a little weight and do about 7 or 8, drop the weight do 5 and then an 8 second isohold where the bar is slightly lower than lockout
On your third set I want you to do a drop set. Do around 10, then go down a little (I dropped 10 lbs), and then go to failure and drop one more time and go to failure.
On your third set, you are going to do a drop set. On this one only do one drop set. So do 8 reps, then drop weight and go crazy until you hit failure.

Do 1 set where you hit failure and you flex hard on every rep and then
lower to the midpoint of the range of motion and hold for 10 seconds
On your last set do a drop set and then an isohold for 10 seconds at the midpoint of the range
Front barbell raises – Simply do 3 sets of 12 here. Bring the barbell up to a few inches above eye level and flex hard for a split second at the top of each rep.
I am not concerned about the stretch and a full range of motion. In fact, don’t even let the weight come down all the way. Just lower it about 2/3 of the way and then drive your elbows back hard!

You are strong from a
stretched position so do your pulldowns heavy but only pull them down to the top of your forehead

Simple do 3 sets of 10 of low rows with a close neutral grip. Hold the contracted position for 1
second and feel your lats stretch by leaning forward just a bit before you row the weight back up

Do sets of 5 working your way up to about 70% of your max. Once you get here go ALL OUT for
your challenge set and see how many reps you can do. Lower than mid shin pin placement
Do these with a supinated grip. I actually DO want you to stretch at the top of these. Do 3 sets of 10.
Banded hyperextensions – Use a band and simply do 3 sets to failure.
Do a supinated curl on one side, and then switch. Alternate to failure (around 12-15 reps). On 3rd stand up and do hammer curls. On 4th go to failure and then do isohold 1/3 way up
I want you to crank out 5 sets of 15 reps with 45 second breaks.
I want you to crank out 5 sets of 15 reps with 45 second breaks on these too.
Add in additional 5 on 3rd set and a 10 sec isohold, add an additional 10 on the 4th set and a 10 sec isohold
Do very slow reps. I want a massive amount of tension to develop
Do 3 sets of 12 taking only 45 seconds between sets.

ss.note: Heavy calf raise on leg press followed by AMRAP of bodyweight standing raises

ex.note: Do plenty of warm ups. Here you are simply going to do 6 sets of 10. Let’s get some blood cranking in your hams. I want you to be able to get all of your reps with perfect form

Just like last week, but let’s try push the weight a little more and of course maintain good form and execution. Do sets of 8 until you get to where 8 is really tough. We will count the last three set

Add a band for extra tension. Work your way up doing sets of20. I want you to put your feet around the middle of the platform. Once you get top weight, do one more set of 20 with 10sec isohold 1/4 way
Find a weight you can do for a nice solid 15 reps and do 4 sets of 15 with it.
On 2nd set, force extra 5 reps and then 10 partials out of the stretch position. Then do an isohold for 10 secs
Work your way up doing sets of 8. Once you get to where 8 is really tough do a drop set with it. Do 8 then drop the weight and do another 6 to 8, then drop the weight and do another 6 to 8.
Do sets of 6 all the way up until you can barely get 6. Try to do these explosively and drive up hard. As usual stop about an inch or two above chest and go to ¾ lockout
Stretch pushups – I want three sets done like this. Go to failure with good form. Then get about 2/3 of the way down and do an iso hold for 8 secs for all 3 sets.

Do 1 set where you hit failure and you flex hard on every rep and then
lower to the midpoint of the range of motion and hold for 10 seconds
On these sit down on a bench. Now grab a pair of dumbbells and do 5 reps on one side and then switch sides. 1st set - 20 reps each side, 2nd - 15 reps, 3rd - 10 reps.  Increase weight each set

Do 3 sets of 15 reps. On all sets do a 10 second isohold at about the
midway point in the last rep to finish the set.

Just do a nice full range of motion set of 15, and then one of 10. Each set
should be too failure. 2 total work sets

Work your way up doing sets of 10 here on each side. Just keep going up
until you start to lose good form because the weight is so heavy.
Do these heavy again this week. Do 5 sets of 8 here! Pull down to the top of your head only just like last week.
Do 3 sets of 12 here. Do these nice and slow and feel your lats stretch!

Lower the bar to just
above your kneecap. That is not very low and pull it right back up and retract your scapulae and flex your spinal erectors. Keep your glutes loose. Don't go too heavy
Do 3 sets of 12 with 3 second holds at the top.
Do a supinated curl on one side, and then switch. Alternate to failure (around 12-15 reps). On 3rd stand up and do hammer curls. On 4th go to failure and then do isohold 1/3 way up
On your 4th set, I want you to go to failure and then have your partner force 5 extra reps. After the forced reps hold the weight at midpoint and do a 10 second isohold
Do 3 sets of 6 with perfect form squeezing as hard as you can. On your 4th set do 6 then drop the weight 20 lbs of so and try to get 6 more. then hold the weight at midpoint for 7 sec isohold

Go to near failure (maybe have -12 more reps in the tank), then go down just a
little and hold for 10 seconds
Just do 3 sets to failure followed by 5 partials out of the bottom on each set. The initial reps before you hit failure should be in the ballpark of 12
10 full, then 10 partials out of the bottom then a 10 sec isohold
Do plenty of warm ups. Here you are simply going to do 4 sets of 12. Use perfect form on all sets. 4 total work sets.
Work your way up doing sets of 8, and stop once you hit a set that is a hard 8 reps. We’ll count the last 3 sets as work sets. Don’t lock out the weight on these, just fire away like a piston
Very simple this week on these as well. Do a couple of sets of 20 to get to a working weight. Once there do 3 sets of 30 reps with it. Use the stance that you feel strongest and most natural in.
Put one foot on a slightly raised platform. I am guessing it was about 2-3 inches off the ground. I stayed in this position and did all my reps on one leg, and then switched to the other leg.

Do 3 sets of 12 here. Come up all the way and flex your glutes. Work the
stretch a little bit deeper each set. Let it happen naturally, don’t force the stretch
Work your way up doing sets of 8. Keep going until you barely get 8 reps. Lock the weight out and squeeze hard on each rep. We’ll count the last 3 sets as work sets.
Do sets of 6 all the way up until you can barely get 6. Try to do these explosively and drive up hard. As usual stop about an inch or two above chest and go to ¾ lockout.

Do the same thing that you did on incline. Do sets of 6 up until you struggle
getting 6. Make that the last set. On these touch your chest with the weight and even pause for a split second.

Try to get a really nice full range of motion stretch on these. It will
feel good after all the pressing.
Simply stand up and do 3 sets of 12 on these. Do a few light sets first to get some blood cranking in your delts.
Do 3 sets of 10, and lower the weight with a 5 second count on all reps. This will burn. You can use either a pronated or neutral grip, either is ok.
Use a moderate width palms facing in toward each other. Sit with your spine straight up and down. Lift your sternum up before pulling down.

Use single handles here - I want you to be able to supinate as you pull your elbows back. Don’t fully
supinate, go about 2/3 of the way to full supination
Do these heavy and really work the stretch. Do 3 sets of 8 with a big weight!
On these you are just going to work up to a weight that is probably about 80% of your one rep max, and I want you to do 5 sets of 3 with it using perfect form
Do 3 to failure with bodyweight only

ss.note:
Pyramid up here. Do sets of 10 and when the weight gets tough, make that your first
set.
Grip the dumbbells on the inside so that it is actually more “weighted” on the outside. Get your elbows in nice and tight and keep your palms up while curling. Full range of motion here
Do sets of 8 here. Flex your bicep as hard as you can throughout the whole set.

Do nice and slow sets of 15 here. Lower the weight behind your head so you
can get some extra range of motion
Supinate as you curl up. Do sets of 8 here. Flex your bis hard through the whole set.
Lower the bar to about 2 inches over your nose. Let your elbows flare out to the side. Feel the stretch. Drive to 3/4 lockout
Heavy calf raise on leg press followed by AMRAP of bodyweight standing raises

ex.note: Do several warm up sets first. Do 4 sets of 12 with a weight that makes this tough. On the 4th set, then tack on 25 partials out of the stretched position.
Do sets of 10 all the way up until you can barely get 10. On the last set, after you rack it, count to 30 and then un-rack it and shoot for another 4-6 reps.
Take these down to just above parallel and hold for a 3 second count and then drive back up explosively. Find a weight that you can do 8 reps with, and shoot for 3 sets like this.
This week we are just going to do standard walking dumbell lunges. I want you to take a total of 10 steps with each leg on each set. If you get that easy, use heavier dumbbells. Do 3 sets like this.

Do 3 sets of 8 here. Come up all the way and flex your glutes. Work the
stretch a little bit deeper each set.
We are going to finish with a drop set on this last one. I want 8 reps, then drop the weight a bit and get another 8, and then do it one more time. Use STRICT form.
Do sets of 6 again this week but use a 3 second descent.

Now after your 3rd set, your 4th set is going to be a drop set with a loaded stretch. So do 8, drop the weight and do 8 again, and then go to
failure after a 3rd and final drop. Loaded Stretch at end
Do 3 sets of 15 here. Hold each rep for a 2 second flex in the contracted position.
Neutral grip. On your 4th set do a drop set. Do 8 reps, drop the weight and do 6-8 more, then drop the weight and do only partials out of the top to failure. Pronated grip for partials
For your delt finisher I want you to do 2 sets of 25 with a heavy weight on these. Remember to straighten your arms and just do little swings here. Tilt your head back
Work up to a weight that is a tough 10, and do 4 sets of 10 with it. On your last set, I want you to let the weight stretch you for 30 seconds after you do your 10 reps.
Work to a heavy 3. This week I want you to change the pin height of where you pulled from last week. It will only need to change a little bit. So either pull from a slightly lower or higher position.

These are to be done heavy and only pulling down to the top of your forehead. Work up to a weight that is very heavy that you may even have to cheat a little to get your 8
reps.
Do 3 to failure with bands that allow you to get about 12 to 15 reps.

ss.note: Pyramid up here. Do sets of 10 and when the weight gets tough, make that your first set. Keep your elbows in tight and really flex hard at the bottom.
Lower the barbell with a 3 second count and then smoothly curl back up and flex hard at the top for 2 seconds
On these you can cheat a little and use your front delt to get the dumbbells up higher so you can squeeze hard in the contracted position.
Do nice and slow 3 second descents here too.

ex.note: 10 full, then 10 partials out of the bottom then a 10 sec isohold
Do several warm up sets and then let’s pyramid up in weight and decrease reps as you go. On your last set do a drop - 8, drop and do 8 more, drop again and do 8 more
Find a weight can do 5 at and do 3 sets with it. Take down to just above parallel for 3 sec pause. On your last set you are going to do a challenge set and just get as many reps as possible.
On these you are going to alternate doing sets with each leg and not stop until you hit 6 rounds on each side. Start with 15 reps and only rest 10 secs between sets
Use a Barbell to anchor feet to the ground

Do 2 sets of 15 here. Come up all the way and flex your glutes. Work the
stretch a little bit deeper each set. Let it happen naturally, don’t force the stretch.

Slight Decline. Once you are warmed up hit a set of 20-25. You should fail in that rep range somewhere. Add more weight and do until you can barely get the last rep. Do this two more times to failure.
Do 5 sets of 5 touching the bar on your chest for 1 second and then exploding to ¾ lockout, and then going right back down.
Pick a weight that you can do 8 reps with using a nice full range of motion, and also flexing for 1 second at the top with. Last set drop set. Do 8, drop, 8 more, drop, to failure, loaded stretch.
Do 3 sets of 30 here. Just get into a rhythm here and pump these until you hit your number.
This week on these we are going to only work the top half of the range of motion with a hard flex at the top.
Nothing complicated here, just execute 4 sets of 10 with perfect form, and your last set, I want you to continue the set by doing little swings.
Work your way up doing sets of 8 with each arm. This is all going to lead to a triple drop set. Once you get to a tough8, then do that and drop the weight and do 8 more, and repeat two more times
These are to be done heavy and only pulling down to the top of your forehead. I would prefer you use a neutral grip attachment to with a shoulder width hand spacing if possible. On last set 20s hold
Use any machine where your chest is supported so that we can keep stress off lower back for now. I prefer you use a Tbar type machine if possible with a pronated grip
Do 3 sets of 12 here and hold the contracted position for 2 seconds and flex on each rep!
Do 3 to failure with bands that allow you to get about 8 to 12 reps. This is lower reps than last week so use more band tension (progress the resistance).

ss.note: Pyramid up here. Do sets of 10 and when the weight gets tough, make that your first set. Keep your elbows in tight and really flex hard at the bottom.
Do these one arm at a time, and do 6 reps on each arm with a 3 second descent, and then do a 10 second iso-hold for each arm as well

Do sets of 12 here. Try to bring these up nice and high to get a good full range of
motion.

The rope will be extending from behind your head to ¾ lockout as you do reps. After your last rep I
want you to lower the rope and let it stretch your tricep for 20 seconds. Do sets of 10.
Pump out 8 reps here and then go right to lying extensions
Do nice and slow sets of 8 here.
Heavy calf raise on leg press followed by AMRAP of bodyweight standing raises

ex.note: Do several warm up sets and keep doing sets of 10 until you get a weight you can barely do for 10. Once you get to this set, turn it into a brutal set. Do 2 10 second isoholds
This is just some good old heavy leg pressing today. Don’t lock out reps, pump them. Simply do sets of 10 until you can barely get 10 reps. That’s it

ss.note: Increase weight as you move through the sets. Start very light with a couple of warm up sets
Try to do these somewhat explosively. Don’t rush to do the squats after the first movement. Take your time and just stroll over.

ex.note:
Occluded leg extensions – As normal, apply wraps to upper thigh by groin to a perceived level of 7 on
tightness, and do your first set at 30 reps. Rest 30 seconds and just go to failure on every set

Add bands and go light here as you won't be able to add much weight. Remember to not let your elbows go past 90 degrees.

Do a feed set or two to get you up to a descent weight and do explosive
sets of 6. Do not lockout or touch chest. Keep constant tension on chest. Take small weight jumps

Do 4 sets of 20 here with a hard flex in the contracted position
Barbell front raises – Do 3 sets of 12 here. Raise these to about eye level.

then use a pronated medium grip for 3 sets.

Climb up in weight as you go doing sets of 8. Keep going until you get to a
really tough 8. We will call this 3 work sets. Remember on these to drive your elbow up hard and
explosively!

ss.note: Pyramid up here. Do sets of 15 and when the weight gets tough, make that your first set. Keep your elbows in tight and really flex hard at the bottom.

We haven’t done too many high reps on these this program so these 15
will probably feel like 100 reps. Welcome to burn city.
Do sets of 12 here. Try to bring these up nice and high to get a good full range of motion. This is the same as last week.

Use a rope. Now pull the rope over and down one side so that the rope is
completely on side.
Use a very slow eccentric here taking 4 seconds to lower the weight, then as you curl up flex hard
Do nice and slow sets of 15 here. Really emphasize the stretch on every rep

ex.note: 10 full, then 10 partials out of the bottom then a 10 sec isohold
Work your way up to a good working weight that you can do for 12 good reps
Do a few sets to get a working weight that feels great for 10 reps. Shoot for 4 sets of 8. By the time you get to the last set with the weight you may or may not be able to get all 8
Place your feet a little lower than usual. You are going to do 20 reps like a piston with no lockout. Each set go up in weight but move feet up a tad too. Keep going till get to top set of 20
Do a few feeder sets, and then do 3 sets of 6. Hold the pause at the bottom for a 5 count and then explode up

Simply do sets of 8 working up to a weight you can barely do for 8. Do not lock these out, keep constant tension on the chest. We will count the last 3 sets as work sets.
Do sets of 8 this week, going up until you can barely get 8. Do not lock these out and don’t touch your chest, stay about 1-2 inches above it. Drive the weight up explosively.
